title: 第15章 出宫刺杀开始第16章 俺叫张言信俺言之有信跪下喊义父
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
看谁不顺眼就刺杀谁嘛？
不过，这也不是不行啊……
陆尘陷入沉思。
“皇儿，在想什么？”
陆尘对面，青帝看到陆尘走神，不由笑呵呵的开口询问。
“嘿嘿，父皇，这不是在想三天后的订婚宴嘛！”
陆尘挠了挠头开口说道。
“哈哈哈，皇儿放心，朕一定给你搞一个风风光光的订婚宴！”
青帝听到此言开口。
“多谢父皇！”
“这个给你，空间戒指，里面有我给你的赏赐，青龙玉佩，天阶至宝，还有龙晶灵晶丹药什么的！”
这个时候，青帝递给了陆尘一个戒指。
“你现在也修炼了，只需要滴血认主，再用用自己的灵力沟通空间戒指，便能打开，自行取用，还有朕赏你的天尘殿，现在正在打扫，你明天应该可以入驻了，现在没事，你可以自行前往宝库中选择任意一样功法神通，一样至宝！”
顿了一下，青帝继续开口。
“嘿嘿嘿，儿臣多谢父皇。”
接过空间戒指，陆尘眼睛发光。
“行了，吃完饭你就出去玩儿吧，朕还有政务要处理！”
青帝对着陆尘挥了挥手。
陆尘开心的走出云霄殿，空间戒指滴血认主，打开空间戒指，大概的扫了一遍，便直接取出青龙玉佩向皇宫外走去。
“他那个畜生。怎么可能，父皇为何如此忠爱于他，不过六岁，便赏赐给他一座宫殿，更是给他青龙玉佩，皇宫内外自由行走，以及如此豪华的修炼资源！”

今早金銮殿发生的事情，很快就在皇宫和众多大臣之间传来，甚至引得皇宫内外的震动，
文武大臣以及宫内皇族都在分析青帝为何对年仅六岁的陆尘如此恩宠。
而灵妙殿，二皇子陆轩啪的一下打碎了一个花瓶，脸色狰狞的的开口。
“哥，杀了他，杀了陆尘那个小畜生？”
一旁，七皇子陆仁脸色同样阴沉无比，
每一次提起陆尘，陆仁都感觉胯下隐隐作痛。
而一旁，二人的母亲灵妃倒是显得冷静，只不过此刻同样脸色阴沉，一双异常的凤眼之中充满了阴郁的神色。
等到陆轩和陆仁冷静下来，灵妃才缓缓开口。
“现在，不管是陛下如此恩宠陆尘，对于我们来说，把陆尘除掉，才是重中之重。轩儿，你不是说想要想方设法的把陆尘引出皇宫嘛？你外公的供奉此刻就在帝都之中等待，随时准备动手！”
灵妃看向陆轩开口。
“母妃，我现在就……”
“娘娘，十一殿下陆尘刚刚独自一人离开了皇宫！”
这边，陆轩话还没有说完，只见一个年轻女子诡异且突兀的出现在灵妃前方开口。
“嗯？”
灵妃陆轩和陆仁听到此言，尽皆大喜。
“简直是天赐良机！”
灵妃惊喜开口。
“让父亲的人动手！”
顿了一下，灵妃咬牙切齿。
“是，娘娘！”

话音落下，年轻女子直接在原地消失。
“还是宫外舒服，宫内跟个牢笼一样！”
这边了，陆尘还不知道自己被盯上了。
content_en:
Just assassinate anyone you don't like?
However, this is not impossible...
Chase Lu fell into deep thought.
"Your Majesty, what are you thinking about?"
Opposite Lu Chen, Qing Emperor saw that Lu Chen was distracted and couldn't help but smile and ask.
"Hey, Father, aren't you thinking about the engagement party in three days?"
Lu Chen scratched his head and said.
"Hahaha, don't worry, Your Majesty, I will definitely give you a glorious engagement party!"
Qingdi heard this and spoke.
"Thank you, Father!"
"This is for you, the space ring. It contains the rewards I gave you, the green dragon jade pendant, the heavenly treasure, and the dragon crystal spirit crystal elixir and so on!"
At this time, Qingdi handed Lu Chen a ring.
"You have also practiced now. You only need to drop your blood to identify the master, and then use your own spiritual power to communicate with the space ring. You can open it and take it by yourself. The Tianchen Palace that I rewarded you with is being cleaned now. You should be able to move in tomorrow. It's okay now. You can go to the treasure house and choose any technique and magical power, and the same treasure!"
After a pause, Qingdi continued to speak.
"Hehehe, thank you very much, my dear father."
After taking the space ring, Lu Chen's eyes glowed.
"Okay, after dinner, you can go out and play. I still have government affairs to deal with!"
Qingdi waved to Lu Chen.
Lu Chen happily walked out of the Yunxiao Palace, recognized the owner of the space ring with blood, opened the space ring, scanned it briefly, then took out the Qinglong Jade Pendant and walked out of the palace.
"He is that beast. How is it possible? Why is my father so loyal to him? When he was only six years old, he rewarded him with a palace, a green dragon jade pendant, the freedom to walk inside and outside the palace, and such luxurious cultivation resources!"
What happened in the Jinluan Palace this morning quickly spread among the palace and many ministers, and even caused shock inside and outside the palace.
The ministers of civil and military affairs and the royal family in the palace were all analyzing why Emperor Qing was so fond of Lu Chen, who was only six years old.
In the Lingmiao Palace, the second prince Lu Xuan smashed a vase and spoke with a ferocious expression.
"Brother, kill him, kill that little beast Lu Chen?"
On the side, the Seventh Prince Lu Ren's face was equally gloomy.
Lu Ren felt a dull pain in his crotch every time he mentioned Lu Chen.
On the side, their mother Ling Fei seemed calm, but her face was also gloomy at this moment, and her pair of abnormal phoenix eyes were filled with a gloomy look.
After Lu Xuan and Lu Ren calmed down, Concubine Ling slowly spoke.
"Now, no matter how favored your majesty is to Lu Chen, for us, getting rid of Lu Chen is the top priority. Xuan'er, didn't you say you want to find ways to lure Lu Chen out of the palace? Your grandfather's tribute is waiting in the imperial capital at this moment, ready to take action at any time!"
Concubine Ling looked at Lu Xuan and spoke.
"Mother, I will..."
"Your Majesty, Your Highness Eleven Lu Chen just left the palace alone!"
Here, before Lu Xuan finished speaking, a young woman appeared strangely and suddenly in front of Concubine Ling and spoke.
"Huh?"
Lingfei Lu Xuan and Lu Ren were overjoyed when they heard this.
“What a God-sent opportunity!”
Concubine Ling spoke in surprise.
"Let father's men take action!"
After a pause, Concubine Ling gritted her teeth.
"Yes, concubine!"
As soon as the words fell, the young woman disappeared directly on the spot.
"It's still comfortable outside the palace, but it's like a prison inside the palace!"
Over here, Lu Chen still didn't know that he was being targeted.
